# Tpscheck

TPSCheck is a service that verifies in real-time if a phone number is registered with the UK's Telephone Preference Service (TPS) or Corporate Telephone Preference Service (CTPS), providing insights on validity, location, type, and provider of the number.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tpscheck/.

## Actions

- **Check Phone Number (TPS/CTPS)** (read-only): Checks if one or more uk phone numbers are registered on the telephone preference service (tps) and/or corporate telephone preference…
